info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Approved Supplier Directory Management API
info.description: The Approved Supplier Directory Management API allows businesses to update information related to their approved suppliers within the banking and enterprise services sector. This endpoint enables users to modify the details of a supplier in the directory, ensuring that the information remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include procurement teams or financial institutions looking to maintain compliance and effective supplier relationships. Utilizing this API helps streamline supplier management processes and enhances operational efficiency.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific entry in the Approved Supplier Directory by providing the resource ID. Make sure to check the request body for required fields.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the approved supplier directory entry identified by RES-100045. The payload should contain all necessary information to modify the existing supplier's details as specified in the schema.
